# Counts, generated by derive.py

Rule S (COUNTING-RULE.md): mul = products of two non-constant values; add = additions and subtractions; neg = negations that cannot be carried as a sign; scl = doublings; MA = mul + add - fused, with scalings left out, and MA+scl with them added.
